name: Valedorn
source:
King Frederick's brother, but also a power-hungry mage.
After he tried to steal the Crimson Emeroth Crystal from the evil Master Altrane, he's been framed into assassination attempt of his brother King Frederick and had to escape from the capital with death sentence on his head.
He then started a rebellion against Master Altrane, manipulating his followers into believing it was for an honorable cause. In truth, he only wants to steal the Crystal and use it to rule over the kingdom.
